correctness.rationale: For primes q≡1 mod4, q≠7, H_q={(y mod7,y modq)=(ε_q(x),x)} in (Z/7q)^× has order q−1, index six, is cyclic and kernel of primitive odd sextic χ7 εq. For each x=1..q−1 CRT lifts y_±=x+q[((±1−x)q^{-1})_7]; sum y_++y_- =7q(q−1), and selecting via ε leads 2Δ=qΣ ε(x)(j_+-j_-). Direct residues r=q mod7 yield six signed restricted sums 2Δ/(7q)=±E_q(S). Each S stable under x↦q−x and ε(−1)=1, giving E_q(S)≡cardinality(S-selected x) mod4 and even, hence 7q|Δ. For r=1..6 the counts 2k,k+1,3k+2,3k+1,k,2k (q=7k+r), and q≡1 mod4, give parity odd for q mod28 in {9,13,25} exactly. Independent explicit CRT computations for q=5,13,17,29,37 yielded defect quotients 0,−1,−2,0,1 respectively, supporting claims but not infinitude proof.
